number.description: Human-readable reference or tracking number for the order.

customer.description: Name or identifier of the customer who placed the order.

total.description: Total monetary amount billed for the order.

currency.description: Three-letter currency code for the order total.

shop.description: Identifier or name of the shop where the order was placed.

orders.description: List of orders returned in the current page.

pageSize.description: Number of order records returned in this page.

maxPageSize.description: Maximum number of records that the server permits per page.

pageSizeCapped.description: Indicates whether the requested page size was reduced to the maximum allowed limit.

query.description: Search term applied to filter the order results, or null if unfiltered.

description: Paginated list of orders matching the query criteria.
